meta.title: Settings
meta.description: Manage your PandaTrack account and preferences.

title: Settings
intro: Manage your profile, sign-in details, and preferences in one place.

username.label: Username
username.helper: Used in your account identity. 3-30 characters, letters, numbers, and single hyphens only. You can save a new username at most once every 7 days.

validation.format: Username can only contain letters, numbers, and single hyphens, with no leading or trailing hyphens.
validation.length: Username must be between 3 and 30 characters.
validation.blocked: This username contains a term that is not allowed.

displayName.label: Display name
displayName.helper: Shown alongside your username. Up to 50 characters.

avatar.label: Profile photo
avatar.helper: Used as your avatar across the app. PNG, JPEG, or WebP, up to 10 MB.
avatar.emptyDescription: Drag and drop or click to choose a file.
avatar.removeDialogLead: Your account will show your initial instead of this image everywhere in the app.
avatar.removeDialogIrreversible: You cannot restore this exact photo after removing it. You can upload a new one anytime.
avatar.editorDescription: Drag to reposition and use the slider to zoom.

errors.validation: Check the field and try again.
errors.unauthorized: You need to be signed in.
errors.usernameTaken: This username is already taken by another account.
errors.rateLimited: You can only change your username once every 7 days. Try again after {date}.
errors.avatarInvalidType: Only PNG, JPEG, and WebP images are accepted.
errors.avatarTooLarge: The selected file is too large. Maximum is 10 MB.
errors.avatarMalformed: The image could not be read. Try a different file.
errors.avatarProcessingFailed: Image processing failed. Try a different file.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.intro: Set your defaults for country, collecting interests, base currency, and budget. All fields are optional.

currency.label: Base currency
currency.helper: Used for budget tracking and order summaries.

country.label: Preferred country
country.helper: Used as your default when browsing stores.

productTypes.label: What types of products do you collect?
productTypes.helper: Shown as default filters when browsing stores.

budgetAmount.label: Monthly budget
budgetAmount.helper: A positive whole number in your base currency. Leave empty for no budget.
budgetAmount.currencyRequired: Set a base currency to enable the budget field.

budgetResetDay.label: Budget resets on
budgetResetDay.helper: Pick the day of the month when a new budget period starts.
budgetResetDay.summaryDay: Resets on day {day} of every month.
budgetResetDay.summaryLastDay: Resets on the last day of every month (day 31, or the last valid day in shorter months).

currencyChangeModal.title: Change base currency?
currencyChangeModal.description: Changing your base currency affects how budget periods are tracked from this month onward. Orders contributing to current and future budget periods may need their currency rate updated. You can review and update affected orders after saving, or do it manually per order later.

errors.unauthorized: You need to be signed in.
errors.validation: Check the fields and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

email.label: Email
email.helper: Used to sign in and for important notifications. You can change it here at most once every 7 days.
email.googleHelper: Your account uses Google. To change your email, update it directly in your Google account.
email.pendingVerification: We've sent a verification link to {email}. Please verify to complete the change.

emailModal.title: Change email
emailModal.descriptionIntro: Enter your new email and current password to confirm.
emailModal.descriptionIrreversible: This change is immediate and irreversible. The new email is what you'll use to sign in from now on.
emailModal.descriptionCooldown: You can only make this change once every 7 days. Double-check the address before you confirm.

validation.fillRequiredFields: Fill in the highlighted fields to continue.

password.helper: Use a strong password and do not reuse it on other sites.

success.passwordSet: Your password was set. You can sign in with Google or email and password.

errors.validation: Check the form fields and try again.
errors.unauthorized: You need to be signed in.
errors.notAllowed: This action is not available for your account.
errors.rateLimited: You can only change your email once every 7 days. Try again after {date}.
errors.sameEmail: Enter an email address different from your current one.
errors.emailTaken: This email is already used by another account.
errors.passwordAlreadySet: A password is already set for this account.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
